scope: Ground pulse and expiry events in the single instance heap; exact cancellation on refresh/scene changes, joint arena identities, strict cold restoration and expired arena effect reclamation.

comparison.projectileNormalization: Existing arena projectile container normalization; sort by launch time/caster/spell; projectile records omit id/sequence/teamId. All combat results, RNG and assets remain compared.

semantics.deliberateFix: Arena previously retained expired ground arrays. Cleanup now follows extended pulses, preserving the final pulse.
semantics.restoration: Tests include missing/mismatched/duplicate identities and events, removed dispatched zones, late pulses, source death, target range/death and both arena scopes.
semantics.fixtureRepairs: Old tests now use registered effect/cast/projectile creation. Meter fixtures include enemies; service fixtures seed a complete party and await actual corpse recovery rather than assuming 30 worker calls.

limitations: No new full browser hunting/quest/five-player/Onyxia loot and distribution acceptance in this change.
Previous native renderer crashes are not all attributed; React performance-buffer cleanup remains in place.
100ms main rule loop, other auras, regeneration, encounter timers and causal budget yielding remain unfinished.
Benchmark has no PostgreSQL/WebSocket/client load and does not establish 2-vCPU capacity or a speedup over the previous implementation.
